# Canvex Studio
> A cinematic web design and development studio helping brands, entrepreneurs, and businesses create immersive digital experiences.

## About
Canvex Studio is a creative design and development studio founded by Dillan Darcheville, based in New York, NY. We specialize in high-end web design, interface design, creative direction, and experience design for clients globally. Our average project turnaround is 2 weeks.

## Services
- Creative Direction: Defining the visual soul of your brand through cinematic design and storytelling.
- Interface Design: High-fidelity UI systems that bridge the gap between aesthetics and functionality.
- Web Development: Architecting fast, responsive, and secure digital products with modern tech stacks (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS).
- Experience Design: Mapping user journeys that are intuitive, delightful, and focused on conversion.

## Projects
- Lumina Real Estate: Premium luxury real estate platform — https://luxury-cobbler-beccc8.netlify.app/
- Volt Fitness: Dynamic fitness application for modern athletes — https://resplendent-bonbon-288501.netlify.app/
- Osteria Roasters: Artisanal coffee shop e-commerce experience — https://serene-bombolone-4f49d1.netlify.app/brew
- Game Changers Gear: Custom sports uniform e-commerce store — https://www.gamechangersgear.com/
